title: Report generation stalled after long uptime
description: A known deadlock in the font cache after long uptime blocks every worker thread. No recent change. The documented mitigation is a restart - the one scenario where restart_service is the right proposal.

alert.name: ReportJobsStalled
alert.description: report-generator completed 0 reports in the last 40 minutes (normal ~30 per 10m).

report-generator: watchdog: thread dump shows 16 threads BLOCKED on lock <0x7f9a2c> held by thread 'pdf-font-cache-loader' (WAITING on <0x7f9b10>)
watchdog: no report completed in 30m; heartbeat missed

changes.author: platform-automation
changes.summary: Bucket lifecycle policy update for reports-archive

past_incidents.title: report-generator deadlock in font cache after long uptime
past_incidents.root_cause: Lock ordering bug between font cache loader and renderer (RPT-311), appears after ~200h uptime
past_incidents.resolution: Restart service; permanent fix scheduled in v2.5

ground_truth.summary: Known lock-ordering deadlock (RPT-311) after 212h uptime; all 16 worker threads are blocked.

fault_variants.name: kb_http_500
fault_variants.rationale: The thread dump alone supports a hang diagnosis.
